description: This file defines a generic internal sealed class 'RoundRobinSelector<T>' implementing resource selection using a round-robin algorithm, primarily for load balancing or distributing tasks/resources among multiple entities.

classes.name: RoundRobinSelector<T>
classes.description: A class implementing a round robin selection algorithm for resources, designed for internal usage within Orleans streaming infrastructure.

methods.name: RoundRobinSelector
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the resource list with a randomly ordered, distinct set of resources and sets the initial last selection index randomly.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Property returning the total number of resources.

methods.name: NextSelection
methods.description: Returns a list of selected resources based on round-robin, avoiding resources already in the existing selection.
